reason: A DingTalk Stream channel plugin that exposes DeepSeek Harness agent sessions through private and group chats, including persistent sessions, access controls, approvals, and host-level tools.

summaries.zh: 通过钉钉 Stream 长连接将私聊和群聊接入 DeepSeek Harness agent，并提供会话管理、访问控制与审批交互。
summaries.en: Connects DingTalk private and group chats to DeepSeek Harness agent sessions through Stream mode with session management, access controls, and in-chat approvals.

capabilities: Connects to DingTalk through the official Stream WebSocket mode
Routes private and group chat messages to persistent host agent sessions
Supports sender and group allowlists plus in-chat approval responses
Allows the connected agent to use bash, read, write, edit, git, network, and skills according to host permissions
Maintains sessions across restarts and automatically reconnects after disconnection
